title: ScheduleDeleteArguments
description: The arguments of the `schedule_delete` tool (`pipeshub@schedules/delete`, ADR-SCH-03 D1): one of the caller's own schedules by id, and exactly what `POST /api/v1/agent-harness/internal/runs/{runId}/schedules/{id}/delete` accepts as `arguments`.

id.description: The schedule's id, as `schedule_find` answered it; never a name.

revision.description: The schedule's `revision` as read before asking: a schedule that changed since is not changed (`SCHEDULE_CHANGED`).
